definitions.explanation: Wood that has been cut and prepared for use in construction or carpentry.

{材木|ざいもく}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
{材木|ざいもく} refers specifically to wood that has been cut and prepared for use in building or carpentry. It emphasizes processed lumber rather than raw or standing trees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {材木|ざいもく}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: lumberyard, lumber dealer
- {材木|ざいもく}⟦{商|しょう}→商：noentry⟧: lumber merchant
- {材木|ざいもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut lumber
- {材木|ざいもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to transport lumber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧: timber, wood (broader term including raw and processed wood; more formal/technical)
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧: tree, wood (most general term)
- ⟦{角材|かくざい}→角材：28391_kakuzai⟧: squared timber
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧: board, plank
